title: house.toml
description: The marker and manifest at the root of a house. house.schema is the version of this schema; its maximum is the newest version this lampstand understands.

reflexes.description: How the reflexes load. The worker always carries each reflex in full.

router.description: What the router's one Reflexes section carries in main sessions: index (the default) is one line per reflex; full is each reflex's whole text, as the worker carries it. Either way the section is measured as the reflex-index surface, under [surfaces.reflex-index].cap.

surfaces.description: L0, the surface registry. Six names are surfaces the compiler measures, each the [surfaces] name of the manifest keys it caps: kernel (manifest key kernel), principle-detail (principle-detail), charter-core (charter-core), reflex-index (reflex-index:<host>, one per host), voice (voice) and worker (worker:<host>, one per host). Any other name registers a surface the compiler does not measure.

cap.description: The surface's cap in characters, replacing the budget profile's default. It rises only by the operator's edit: in rules and agreement mode a compile that raises a cap and grows the surface it caps is refused, so a raise is compiled and committed before the text grows. The kernel cap never rises above 4000 (Hermes's kernel prompt section, measured with its framing); a higher one is refused. The worker cap is W's room beyond K: it rises freely for OMP, which imposes no limit, while on Hermes it stops at 20000, what fits Hermes's 32000-character subagent context beside K and a role brief.
